title: 2009 HMMT February Combinatorics Problem 3
statement: In how many ways can you rearrange the letters of "HMMTHMMT" such that the consecutive substring "HMMT" does not appear?

solutions.text: There are \(8!/(4!2!2!)=420\) ways to order the letters. If the permuted letters contain "HMMT", there are \(5 \cdot 4!/ 2!=60\) ways to order the other letters, so we subtract these. However, we have subtracted "HMMTHMMT" twice, so we add it back once to obtain 361 possibilities.
